title: Minimal main
body: In C99 and later, what must the return type of the entry-point function main be?
hint: It is written right before the name main.
explanation: main must return int; `void main` is non-standard (though accepted by some compilers).

title: Declaration list

explanation: In a declaration the comma separates declarators; `4` and `3` are not valid declarators — this is a compiler error.

title: Wild pointer
body: Which line causes undefined behavior?
hint: The pointer is never given a valid address.
explanation: p is uninitialized; dereferencing it (line 2) writes to an indeterminate address — undefined behavior.

title: String length
body: Type the exact output.
hint: strlen counts characters up to the null terminator.
explanation: Hello has 5 characters; the null terminator is not counted.

title: Passing arrays
body: When an array name is passed as a function argument, what does it decay to? (one word)
explanation: An array argument decays to a pointer to its first element.

title: Structure access
body: Given a pointer p to a struct with a field x, which expression is correct?
hint: Use the arrow operator for pointers.
explanation: For a struct pointer, p->x is the correct member access (equivalent to (*p).x).

title: Missing header
body: Will this compile as C (without any extra headers)?
hint: Is bool a built-in type in C?
explanation: bool is not a keyword in classic C; you need <stdbool.h>. Without it this is a compile error.

title: Dereferencing NULL
body: This program has undefined behavior. What is the root cause?
hint: Whether it crashes or not, the program is wrong.
explanation: Dereferencing a NULL pointer is always undefined behavior.

title: Off-by-one
body: The loop reads n+1 elements and causes a buffer over-read. Give the corrected loop condition: for(i=0; i<=n; i++)
explanation: The condition should be i < n so indices stay within 0..n-1.

title: Sum 1..N
body: Write a program that reads a single integer N and prints the sum 1 + 2 + ... + N. Run it locally and submit the output for N = 5.

title: Side effect sequencing
body: Why is this undefined?
hint: Two side effects that modify i, and a read, all unsequenced.
explanation: i is modified twice and read between unsequenced side effects — the result depends on nothing reliable: undefined behavior.

title: Size of char literal
body: In standard C (on a typical 32-bit int platform), what is sizeof('a')?
hint: A character literal is an int, not a char, in C.
explanation: In C, 'a' has type int, so sizeof('a') == sizeof(int) == 4 on a 32-bit int platform.

title: Sum of digits
body: Write a program that reads an integer and prints the sum of its decimal digits. Run it locally and submit the output for input 123.

title: const assignment
body: What is the compile error in this code?
hint: A const object cannot be assigned to.
explanation: x is const (and a const at block scope is uninitialized here, another error); assigning x = 5 is a compile error.
